info.title: API.SH: Yahoo Finance
info.description: The Yahoo Finance API from API.SH: public Yahoo Finance data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Analyst price targets (high, low, mean, median), the consensus recommendation and number of analysts, the monthly recommendation trend (strong buy to strong sell counts) and the full history of upgrades and downgrades (date, firm, action, from/to grade, price target change), newest first. Pages with `offset`/`limit` (pass `next_offset`; null at the end). `similar_symbols` lists the symbols people also watch.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/yahoo-finance-analysts

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rating changes per page (default 100, up to 5000).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Rating-change offset. Pass `next_offset` from the previous response.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Earnings, IPO, splits and economic calendars
get.description:
Events between `from` and `to` (exclusive, up to 92 days). earnings: symbol, company, event, date and time (BMO/AMC), EPS estimate, reported EPS, surprise %, market cap (largest first). ipo: symbol, company, exchange, date, price range, offer price, shares, deal type. splits: symbol, company, date, old and new shares, optionable. economic: event, country, date, period, actual, consensus, prior. Pages with `offset`/`count`; pass `next_offset` (null on the last page).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/yahoo-finance-calendar

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Day after the last day (YYYY-MM-DD, default from + 1 day).

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Earnings region (us default, gb, de, in, ...).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Economic events of one country (US, GB, DE, JP, ...).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Event offset. Pass `next_offset` from the previous response.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Price bars for one symbol: time, open, high, low, close, adjusted close and volume per bar, plus dividends, splits and earnings dates in the period. Use `range` or `period1`/`period2`. Intraday intervals are limited to recent ranges (1m: 7 days, 60m: 2 years).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/yahoo-finance-chart

parameters.name: prepost
parameters.description: true to include pre- and post-market bars.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Next earnings date with EPS and revenue estimate ranges; earnings history (EPS actual vs estimate, surprise) for the last 4 quarters; quarterly EPS chart; yearly and quarterly revenue and earnings; analyst estimates for the current and next quarter and year (EPS and revenue: average, low, high, number of analysts, year-ago value, growth), EPS trend (7, 30, 60, 90 days ago) and EPS revisions; growth estimates against the index, industry and sector.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/yahoo-finance-earnings

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Income statement, balance sheet or cash flow statement, annual, quarterly or trailing twelve months: one row per period (newest first) with every line item Yahoo Finance shows (total revenue, cost of revenue, gross profit, operating expenses, EBIT, EBITDA, net income, EPS, shares; assets, liabilities, equity, debt, cash; operating, investing and financing cash flow, capital expenditure, free cash flow, buybacks, dividends paid, ...). `statement=all` returns the three statements under `statements`; one statement returns its rows under `periods`. Annual history covers about 4 years, quarterly about 5 quarters.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/yahoo-finance-financials

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: annual (default), quarterly or trailing (trailing twelve months; income and cash flow only).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

get.description:
Calls and puts for one expiration date (the nearest by default): contract symbol, strike, last price, change, bid, ask, volume, open interest, implied volatility, in-the-money flag, last trade date. `expiration_dates` lists every expiration and `strikes` every strike; `quote` is the underlying quote. `straddle=true` pairs the call and put of each strike.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/yahoo-finance-options

parameters.name: straddle
parameters.description: true to pair calls and puts by strike.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Quotes for up to 50 symbols (stocks, ETFs, indices such as ^GSPC, currencies such as EURUSD=X, crypto such as BTC-USD, futures): price, change, previous close, open, day range, volume, market cap, bid/ask, pre/post-market price, 52-week range, P/E, EPS, dividend yield, analyst rating, market state and next earnings date; `fields` holds every value Yahoo returns. Unknown symbols are listed in `not_found`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/yahoo-finance-quote

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The symbols Yahoo Finance recommends alongside a ticker ("people also watch"), with Yahoo's score and each one's quote (price, change, volume, market cap...). `quotes=false` returns the symbols only.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/yahoo-finance-recommendations

parameters.name: symbol

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Yahoo Finance's predefined screeners with full quotes: day_gainers, day_losers, most_actives, most_shorted_stocks, small_cap_gainers, undervalued_growth_stocks, undervalued_large_caps, aggressive_small_caps, growth_technology_stocks, top_mutual_funds, conservative_foreign_funds, high_yield_bond, portfolio_anchors, solid_large_growth_funds, solid_midcap_growth_funds, all_cryptocurrencies_us and more (`known_screeners`). Or screen stocks with your own criteria (any of `sector`, `industry`, `exchange`, `region`, `market_cap_min`, `market_cap_max`, `price_min`, `price_max`, `volume_min`, `sort`, `sort_order`; not together with `id`): the response has id `custom` and echoes the applied `criteria`. Pages with `offset`/`count`; pass `next_offset` (null on the last page).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/yahoo-finance-screener

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Result offset. Pass `next_offset` from the previous response.

parameters.name: sector
parameters.description: Custom screen: comma-separated sectors: Basic Materials, Communication Services, Consumer Cyclical, Consumer Defensive, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, Industrials, Real Estate, Technology, Utilities.

parameters.name: industry
parameters.description: Custom screen: comma-separated industry names, e.g. Semiconductors, Software - Infrastructure.

parameters.name: exchange
parameters.description: Custom screen: comma-separated exchange codes, e.g. NMS (Nasdaq), NYQ (NYSE), ASE (NYSE American).

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Custom screen: market, two-letter country code (default us), e.g. gb, de, in.

parameters.name: market_cap_min
parameters.description: Custom screen: minimum market cap in the listing currency, e.g. 10000000000.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
